mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) FROM shop_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3)) AS total_sales_amount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) FROM shop_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND CAST(o.create_time AS DATE) = CURRENT_DATE) AS today_sales_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3)) AS total_order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND CAST(o.create_time AS DATE) = CURRENT_DATE) AS today_order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_product p WHERE p.deleted = 0) AS product_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_product p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1) AS on_sale_product_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_product_category c WHERE c.deleted = 0) AS category_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_gallery_image g WHERE g.deleted = 0) AS gallery_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_admin a WHERE a.deleted = 0) AS admin_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_product p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.stock <= #{lowStockThreshold}) AS low_stock_product_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_product p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND CAST(p.create_time AS DATE) = CURRENT_DATE) AS today_new_product_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.sales_volume), 0) FROM shop_product p WHERE p.deleted = 0) AS total_sales_volume

SELECT CAST(o.create_time AS DATE) AS sale_date, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS sales_amount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM shop_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND o.create_time >= #{startTime} AND o.create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY CAST(o.create_time AS DATE) ORDER BY sale_date ASC

SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(p.id) AS product_count FROM shop_product_category c LEFT JOIN shop_product p ON p.category_id = c.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.sort ORDER BY product_count DESC, c.sort ASC

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, p.price AS price, COALESCE(p.sales_volume, 0) AS sales_volume, p.stock AS stock FROM shop_product p WHERE p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.sales_volume DESC, p.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
